LandRecord.title: LandRecord
LandRecord.description: Authoritative source record held by the Land Registry, and the ONLY source of a LandOwnershipCredential's claims. services/land-issuer resolves the AUTHENTICATED national id to its own farmerId mapping and then to exactly one owned land record; a caller may not select farmerId or landId. The Land Registry keeps its own nationalId mapping on purpose (DESIGN section 4): one issuer must not depend on another issuer's unsigned client state. Synthetic data only: see scripts/seed-agriculture.sh.

landId.title: Land ID
landId.description: Identifies the owned land record, e.g. LAND-MYS-820137. A different namespace and sequence from nationalId and farmerId. Issued as a disclosable claim but never requested by the bank.

nationalId.title: National ID
nationalId.description: Issuer-side authentication lookup only, e.g. NAT-90018472. Matched against the authenticated account's nationalId claim. NEVER issued as a credential claim and never disclosed to the bank.

farmerId.title: Farmer ID
farmerId.description: The Agriculture relationship, e.g. FRM-KA-0041. Issued in this credential so that a bank can correlate it against the Farmer credential's farmerId. Correlation is checked only AFTER both credentials verify and are proven bound to the same holder — matching values alone are not sufficient.

ownershipStatus.title: Ownership status
ownershipStatus.description: ACTIVE is required for eligibility. Any other value is a verified business answer, NOT a verification failure.

landAreaAcres.title: Total land area, acres
landAreaAcres.description: The registry's total for the parcel. Issued as a disclosable claim but never requested by the bank: the loan uses cultivated area only, so total holding size stays with the farmer.

cropType.title: Crop type
cropType.description: Controlled demo vocabulary. The loan rate is looked up from version-controlled policy, so a crop outside the policy produces NOT ELIGIBLE rather than an error.

cultivatedAreaAcres.title: Cultivated area, acres
cultivatedAreaAcres.description: The authoritative input to the loan calculation. Must satisfy 0 <= cultivatedAreaAcres <= landAreaAcres; scripts/seed-agriculture.sh refuses to seed a record that breaks it, because the registry cannot express the cross-field rule itself.

district.title: District
district.description: Issued as a disclosable claim. Not requested by the bank.
